profile_text.body:
Credo AI was founded in 2020. Its website describes the company as the trusted leader in AI governance and says it created the AI governance category. The platform is intended to help enterprises discover AI, enforce policies, prove compliance, and manage risk across models, agents, and applications. It uses a knowledge graph that fuses global regulatory intelligence with business context, and the company says it is now defining agent governance, including a registry for every agent and purpose-built agentic risk controls.

The platform includes policy packs for the EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, ISO 42001, and other standards. A product called GAIA, or Govern AI Assistant, is described as generally available and intended to compress weeks of governance work into hours. The site includes customer statements from Mastercard and IBM. Mastercard says it uses the platform to manage AI risk and implement generative AI, and IBM describes a collaboration on Compliance Accelerators. The product note describes the platform as purpose-built AI governance with policy packs for the EU AI Act and NIST AI RMF, a clean interface, and fast deployment.
